questions.message:
Smoke test still fails: HTTP 403 "source not permitted". This is box access, not our ORD-229[REDACTED] code. The staging gateway admits a request only if the source IP is on the ingress allowlist OR the request carries a valid X-OF-Session. This fresh box is neither \u20[REDACTED]4 your old box's IP was allowlisted, this one isn't, and no session is set. No stored credential on the box, and there's no self-service way to mint a session outside the console.

Two legit paths, each needs something from you:

[REDACTED]) Fastest, lets you see it pass today: in the staging console open devtools -> Network, copy the X-OF-Session value off any gateway request, and paste it back to me. I'll export OF_SESSION and run the smoke. A session lasts ~[REDACTED]hr, so your afternoon re-runs may need a fresh paste.

2) Durable: add this box's edge IP to infra/allowlist.yaml. Post-Q3 that's a PR dana (codeowner) has to approve \u20[REDACTED]4 self-add is disabled now. Snag: this box only presents a container IP ([REDACTED]72.[REDACTED]8.0.3), not a real [REDACTED]0.x edge IP, so I don't know what to request. If you want this, send the correct edge IP for devbox-tberg-02 plus a go-ahead and I'll open the PR for dana to approve.

I did NOT run allowlist-request to self-add, since infra changes now require dana's codeowner approval and the only IP I could add is this ephemeral container one.

Which do you want \u20[REDACTED]4 paste me a session token (fast), or should I open the allowlist PR (durable)?
